Source: The researchers collected information from 110 farmers, about how much wood their trees produce, and how long that wood lasts for their family.
Luganda: Abanoonyereza baakuŋŋaanya obubaka okuva ku balimi 110 nga babuuza ku bungi bw’enku obuva ku miti gyabwe, n’ebbanga enku ezo lye zimala nga bazifumbisa mu famire.
Yoruba: Àwọn olùwaádìí gba ọ̀rọ̀ láti ẹnu àwọn àgbẹ̀ 110, nípa iye igi tí ọ̀gbìn igi wọn máa ń fún wọn, àti iye ìgbà tí igi náà máa ń tó ẹbí wọn láti lò.
Zulu: Abacwaningi baqoqe ulwazi kubalimi abangama-110 lokuthi izihlahla zabo zikhiqiza izinkuni ezingakanani, nokuthi imindeni yabo izisebenzisa isikhathi esingakanani.
Hausa: Masu binciken sun tattara bayanai daga manoma guda 110, game da yawan itacen da bishiyoyi suke samarwa, da kuma tsawon lokacin da itacen yake daɗewa ga danginsu.
Northern Sotho: Banyakišiši ba kgobokeditše tshedimošo go tšwa go balemi ba 110, mabapi le gore mehlare ya bona e tšweletša dikgong tše dikaakang, le gore dikgong tšeo di tšea lebaka le lekaakang ka malapeng a bona.
Amharic: ተመራማሪዎቹ ከ110 ገበሬዎች፣ ዛፎቻቸው ምን ያህል እንጨት እንደሚያመርቱና ያ እንጨት ለቤተሰባችው ለምን ያህል ጊዜ እንደሚበቃ መረጃ ሰብስበዋል።

Source: In other studies, which ran from 2015-2016, the researchers focused on intercropping practices in comparison to growing a single type of crop.
Luganda: Mu kunoonyereza okulala okwakolebwa mu 2015-2016, abanoonyereza baatunuulira ebikolebwa mu kutabika ebirime nga bageraageranya ku kulima ekika ky’ekirime ekimu.

Zulu: Kolunye ucwaningo olwaqutshwa ngo-2015 kuya ku-2016, abacwaningi babegxile ekutholeni umehluko phakathi kwendlela yokutshala ngokuhlwanyela ndawonye imbewu yombila wohlobo olungafani, kanye nokuhlwanyela owohlobo olulodwa ndawonye.
Hausa: A cikin wasni nazarin, wanda ya gudana daga shekarar 2015 zuwa 2016, masu binciken sun mayar da hankali a kan ayyukan haɗakar idan aka kwatanta da shuka nau’in amfanin gona guda ɗaya.

Source: Working with local farmers, they set up nearly 400 plots, growing either maize or cassava, and intercropping with plants that increase soil fertility, specifically legumes (beans and peas).
Luganda: Okukolagana n’abalimi b’omu kitundu baateekateeka puloti 400 nga zirmwako kasooli oba muwogo, nga batabikamu n’ebirime ebirala ebyongera ku bugimu bw’ettaka, naddala ebyempeke (ebijanjaalo ne kawo).

Zulu: Ukusebenza nabalimi basendaweni, kwasifundisa ukuthi balima izinsimu ezingu-400, batshale ikhasava noma batshale umbila ongafani mdawonye nezihlahla ezivundisa umhlabathi, kakhulukazi ezikabhontshisi nophizi.
Hausa: Aiki tare da manoman yankin, sun kafa filaye kusan guda 400, suna noma ko dai masara ko rogo, tare da haɗakar shuke-shuken da suke ƙara yawan amfanin ƙasar gona, musamman kayan abincin gida (wake da fis).
Northern Sotho: Ka go šomišana le balemi ba kgauswi, ba ile ba hloma dipholoto tša go nyaka go fihla go tše 400, fao go bjetšwego lefela goba cassava, gomme ba di bjala mmogo le dimela tšeo di oketšago go nona ga mobu, kudukudu dilekumu (dinawa le dinyebu).
Amharic: በአካባቢው ካሉ ገበሬዎች ጋር በመተባበር፣ በቆሎ ወይም ካሳቫ የሚያበቅሉ እስከ የአፈር ለምነትን ከሚጨምሩ ተክሎች ጋር በተለይ አተር እና ሽንብራ ዘሮችን አዳብለው በመዝራት 400 የእርሻ ቦታዎችን አዘጋጅተዋል።

Source: They wanted to see if intercropping could help farmers produce more food, and if growing drought resistant crops like cassava and pigeon pea could make farms more resilient.
Luganda: Baayagala okumanya oba ng’okutabika ebirime kiyinza okuyamba abalimi okukungula emmere esingako, era n’okulaba oba ng’okulima ebirime ebigumira ekyeya nga muwogo ne kawo biyinza okufuula faamu ezo ez’amaanyi.

Zulu: Babefuna ukubona ukuthi ukutshala ndawonye imbewu yohlobo olungafani, kungabasiza yini abalimi ukuthi bakhiqize ukudla okuningi, nokuthi ukutshala ikhasava kanye ne-pigeon pea kungakwazi yini okwenza amapulazi akwazi ukubhekana nezinselelo zesimo sezulu.

Luganda: Okusobola okupima obulungi bw’ebintu byonna ebikolebwa, abanoonyereza baatunuulira amakungula, oba obungi bw’enku oba emmere, ebiva mu buli mbeera.
Yoruba: Láti ṣe òdiwọ̀n àṣeyọrí àwọn ìṣe wọ̀nyí, àwọn olùwádìí ṣe àgbéyẹ̀wò àwọn èrè oko, tàbí iye igi tàbí oúnjẹ, èyí tí wọ́n ń gbé jádé ní kéèsì kọ̀ọ̀kan.

Northern Sotho: Go ela katlego ya ditiro tše, banyakišiši ba ile ba lebelela puno, goba tekano ya dikgong goba ya dijo, tšeo di tšweleditšwego.

Hausa: Sun kuma auna yawan amfanin gonakin da aka noma gabaɗaya lokacin da aka haɗa yawan amfanin gona da albarkatu daban-daban.
Northern Sotho: Ba ile gape ba ela ka fao naga e tšweleditšego ka gona ka kakaretšo ge puno ya dibjalo tše di fapanego e kopantšwe.

Source: In most cases, they found that these practices did help farmers to meet climate smart goals.

Northern Sotho: Dipuno tša dikgong tša balemi di ile tša fapana go eya ka mohuta wa mehlare le gore e be e bjetšwe kae.
